scripts.check: for file in js/*.js sync-worker/src/*.js; do node --check "$file" || exit 1; done
scripts.limits: for file in index.html service-worker.js js/*.js css/*.css sync-worker/src/*.js; do lines=$(wc -l < "$file"); if [ "$lines" -gt 400 ]; then echo "$file supera 400 líneas ($lines)"; exit 1; fi; done
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm test && npm run limits
